description: Keyframe timeUs bounds contract: every keyframe must lie within [0, clip.timelineDurationUs], BOTH ends inclusive. Consumed by packages/timeline-schema/tests/invariants.test.ts (zod validateTimelineDoc) and backend/tests/VideoEdit.UnitTests/KeyframeBoundsParityTests.cs (ExportCompiler.Validate); both runners exercise every case on a visual channel (opacity) AND the audio channel (volume). The 9600000-in-a-5000000-clip case is the audited live reproduction that used to pass the C# gate and freeze the rendered ramp at its last sampled value (round 13, C1).
